answer: One vault holds a fixed 40,000 pool. Each agent locks 70 credits and files one pigment-sealed claim; each epoch the vault splits 40,000 across claims, so a new identity shrinks every share. A bridge registry links claims to work and burns rented or reused pigment seals. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 × 40 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool: the thousandth earns 40, its fee; the next, less. One honest claim costs 40, keeps its whole share.
